verdict.rationale: Pricing terms such as seat minimums and annual commitments are a fair question for a SaaS project-management product, so the axis applies. The pricing-page evidence lists only features (templates, automations, integrations, roadmaps). It says nothing about minimum seat counts, annual-only billing or commitment terms.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
